summary: This page features an interview with Russell Ng, CEO of AA REIT, discussing FY2026 performance including revenue of S$190.7 million, Net Property Income of S$141.3 million, and Distributions to Unitholders of S$80.6 million. The report highlights portfolio occupancy at 93.6% (96.8% with committed leases), the completion of Asset Enhancement Initiatives at 7 Clementi Loop and 15 Tai Seng Drive, and a Weighted Average Lease Expiry (WALE) of 4.0 years.

This page displays the AIMS AA REIT Trust Structure flowchart and text detailing the organizational hierarchy between Unitholders, The Trust (AIMS AA REIT), The Manager (AIMS APAC REIT Management Limited), The Trustee (HSBC Institutional Trust Services (Singapore) Limited), two Holding Trusts, and property entities including Singapore Properties and Australia Properties.

This page presents the **Statement of Total Return and Distribution** for SGX REIT, reporting FY2026 and FY2025 figures in S$'000. The table details gross revenue of 190,665 S$'000 (FY2026) versus 186,626 S$'000 (FY2025), leading to total return after income tax of 131,196 S$'000 attributable to unitholders and perpetual securities holders, with distributions per unit (DPU) rising from 9.600 to 9.850 Singapore cents.

This page details the financial review of AA REIT, featuring a table on net changes in fair value of derivative financial instruments and an artifact listing Perpetual Securities issuance and redemption details with specific reporting units in S$ million. The main content describes the distribution policy and FY2026 distribution to Unitholders of S\$80.6 million, explaining that this amount was 100% of Singapore taxable income available for distribution, higher than FY2025 due to increased net property income and lower borrowing costs, partially offset by marketing commissions, insurance claim absence, reduced management fees, and higher returns attributable to Perpetual Securities holders.

This page presents the **Total Assets and Net Asset Value (NAV) per Unit** table reporting figures in **S$'000**, detailing total assets of S\$2,464.0 million and NAV per unit of S\$1.28 as at 31 March 2026, alongside narrative explanations of asset growth driven by property acquisitions, valuation gains, and currency impacts, and liability increases due to operating payables, lease extensions, and borrowing drawdowns offset by new security issuances. The section concludes with cash flow highlights showing a year-on-year increase in cash and cash equivalents to S\$53.2 million, attributed to stronger operating cash flows partially offset by financing and investing outflows, directing readers to pages 185–186 for the consolidated statement of cash flows.

This page presents the **KEY FINANCIAL METRICS** table (Gross borrowings, Total Assets, Aggregate Leverage ratio, Weighted average all-in cost of debt, Interest coverage ratio, Weighted average term to maturity, Fixed rate borrowings) and the **FINANCIAL FLEXIBILITY & LIQUIDITY** table (Cash and bank balances, Undrawn committed facilities, Issue capacity under Euro Medium Term Notes Programme), both reporting in S$'million as at 31 March 2026 and 2025, alongside textual disclosures on capital management milestones including Sustainability Linked Loan targets and subordinated perpetual securities issuances.

This page presents AA REIT's capital management data, led by a table and chart detailing the Aggregate Leverage Ratio (26.8% as at 31 March 2026) alongside financial flexibility figures of S$263.4 million and a debt maturity profile table for FY 2027–2030. The reporting unit is explicitly stated as SGD'000 (S$) for flexible assets and leverage metrics, while the Debt Maturity Profile uses USD millions ($'million).

This page presents key portfolio highlights for AA REIT as at 31 March 2026, featuring a main artifact displaying 28 properties with a total value of S\$2.25 billion, 788,363 sqm net lettable area, 93.6% occupancy, and 4.0 years WALE in SGD'000. The section details the portfolio composition across industrial sub-sectors in Singapore and Australia, noting diversified tenants (>180) and positive rental reversions of 7.7%, while clarifying that all gross revenue references relate to FY2026 unless stated otherwise.

This page details AA REIT's active asset management activities in FY2026, including two Australian Economic Investment Initiative (AEI) projects, a divestment of 3 Toh Tuck Link at a 32.5% premium to valuation, an acquisition of 2 Aljunied Ave 1 delivering a DPU accretion of 2.5%, and a post-year-end divestment of 8 Senoko South Road at an 11.1% premium. The page also presents the Top-N tenants/customers table for FY2026, listing the top 10 customers by gross revenue from income (GRI), their primary trade sectors, percentage of portfolio GRI contribution, and weighted average lease expiry (WALE).

This page presents a portfolio review featuring the main artifact "Tenant Trade by FY2026 GRI" table, which details industry distribution (Logistics 27.4%, Food & Staples 18.5%, Data Centre and Telecommunications 13.9%), alongside occupancy data tables comparing AA REIT Singapore Portfolio and Total Portfolio rates against JTC Industrial Average for FY2026 quarters and historical comparisons up to 31 March 2026.

The reporting unit is not explicitly stated in the text or tables provided.
